verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own Directory Sync docs say directory updates 'can be delivered to you via webhooks or retrieved using the Events API,' and that Directory Sync 'sends automatic updates to your app.' That is first-party outbound event delivery, but the evidence only covers directory events and gives no detail on how a consumer registers an endpoint. missing for 10: documented webhook endpoint registration/subscription management, event coverage beyond Directory Sync (e.g. auth, user management, audit logs), signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
